answer: Temporal Proof of Active Attention. Agents must periodically solve dynamic data puzzles streaming from a secure beacon to maintain validity. This replaces static verification with ongoing cognitive labor. An attacker scaling ten thousand fake agents must dedicate continuous GPU cycles and memory bandwidth to these real-time tasks. Like bees harvesting scarce nectar across endless fields, scaling operations burns vast compute that cannot be faked or cached. If an attacker diverts resources to build an ivory tower of idle profiles, the neglected nodes drop instantly.
